name: Organiza Simple
description: Uruguayan online store selling home organization and decor items: labelled boxes, organizers, shelves, kitchen, tableware and desk accessories. Ships nationwide; interior orders go by DAC.
description_es: Tienda online uruguaya de organización y decoración del hogar: cajas rotuladas, organizadores, estantes, cocina, vajilla y escritorio. Envía a todo el país; el interior por DAC.

ships_to.notes: Free shipping nationwide over a stated order threshold; Montevideo by private courier in 24-48 business hours, interior by DAC to home or branch

fulfillment.pickup_notes: The shipping page lists no in-store pickup; DAC branch pickup is offered for interior orders. A physical store exists in Montevideo but the page does not say online orders can be collected there.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

sources.supports: Shipping terms: nationwide free shipping over a threshold, Montevideo courier 24-48 business hours, interior via DAC home or branch
